Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

A faction of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} who split from their Gypsy heritage after the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s formation, these antitribu retain their parent clan's nomadic instincts and gift for illusion while pledging themselves to the Sword of Caine.

Disciplines: Animalism, Chimerstry, Fortitude

Advantage: Ravnos can often get away with cons and deceptions that would land other Cainites in serious trouble.

Disadvantage: Each Ravnos has a particular “signature crime.” Once each game session the Ravnos must attempt to indulge that vice unless they pass a Self-Control/Instinct Test (difficulty 3 Traits), with the usual risks for a failed Virtue Test.

Organization: True to their roots, Ravnos antitribu favor mobile, loosely affiliated bands over fixed haven life, moving between Sabbat territories as opportunity and vice dictate.
